rules_verified.V: edges at x = pos +- w/2 on the surface (no rotation); bottom at x = pos, r = mean(r_left_edge, r_right_edge) - depth (P1, P16 centre/off-centre, P11)
rules_verified.square: 45deg chamfer 0.1x0.1 outside nominal width on both sides (chamfer follows surface: inner point = outer point - 0.1 radially); vertical walls; flat floor at r = min(outer edge r) - depth; nominal width = floor width; total opening = w + 0.2

rules_verified.convex: two side walls of height h(0.1) at pos +- w/2 (rotated with chord on domes), floor is a convex arc whose apex is flush with the original surface (sagitta h)
rules_verified.perlage: channel width w, depth 0.1 (0.05 chamfer at rims), beads diameter 7/9*w as spheres (perlageHeight = perlageWidth), touching, count ~ floor(2*pi*R_bead/d)
rules_verified.edge_normal: rabbet w x d at the ring edge (engine: rect groove of width 2w centred on the edge)
